extension.author: SEOWebChecker
extension.license: GNU General Public License version 2 or later; see LICENSE.txt
extension.description: Automated on-page technical SEO audits, heading structure inspections, image accessibility analysis, and Core Web Vitals checks for Joomla 5.

field.name: min_score
field.label: Minimum SEO Score
field.description: Minimum acceptable score before warning administrators.

field.name: check_images
field.label: Check Image Alt Attributes
field.description: Verify image accessibility alt tags across content.

field.name: check_headings
field.label: Check Heading Hierarchy
field.description: Detect missing or duplicate H1 headings.
